answer: A stake bond resists Sybil attacks by making each agent lock collateral that is slashed on proven misbehavior. Spawning a thousand sock puppets means locking a thousand bonds, so attack cost scales with size: a comet tail of fake accounts still needs real money behind every one. New identities start under velvet-glove limits, small transaction caps until they prove themselves. The summit of the design is that Sybil identities are cheap to create but expensive to make useful, flipping the attacker economics.
